args.body:
Dear New Asiaway Private Dining Team,

I would like to request a table for 12 people for next Friday, May 24, 2024.

Could you please let me know if a table for a party of this size is available that day, and if so, what time slots you could accommodate? If possible, we would prefer a private dining setting.

Please feel free to reach me at this email address or by phone at 327-420-4923.

Thank you very much for your assistance. I look forward to hearing from you.

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
Blue Sparrow Tech
emma.johnson@bluesparrowtech.com
